## Problem

What are you trying to do that DockShift doesn't help with today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If it touches a specific panel (clipboard, terminal, AI, etc.), say
which.

## Alternatives considered

Other tools or workarounds you've tried, and why they fall short.

## Scope check

- [ ] This fits DockShift's focus as a lightweight floating dock (not a full replacement for
      a dedicated app)
- [ ] This works as a Windows-only feature, or I've noted the cross-platform implications

## Additional context

Mockups, links, or anything else that helps explain the idea.
